1.text: “Aya mategeko ni yo uzashyira imbere yabo.

2.text: Nugura umugurano w'Umuheburayo agukorere imyaka itandatu, ku wa karindwi azagende abe uw'umudendezo, atagize icyo yicunguje.

3.text: Niba yaraje wenyine agende wenyine, niba yarazanye n'umugore we ajyane na we.

4.text: Kandi shebuja namushyingira umugore bakabyarana abahungu cyangwa abakobwa, uwo mugore n'abana be bazabe aba shebuja uwo, ariko uwo mugabo agende wenyine.

5.text: Ariko uwo mugurano niyerura ati ‘Nkunze databuja n'umugore wanjye n'abana banjye, sinshaka kugenda ngo mbe uw'umudendezo’,

6.text: shebuja amujyane imbere y'Imana amuhagarike ku rugi cyangwa ku nkomanizo, shebuja amupfumuze ugutwi uruhindu, agumye kumukorera iteka.

7.text: “Umuntu nagura umukobwa we ngo abe umugurano, ntagenzwe kumwe n'abagurano b'abagabo.

8.text: Niba atanejeje shebuja wagambiriye kumurongora, yemere ko acungurwa. Ntiyemererwe kumugurisha abanyamahanga kuko yamuviriye mu isezerano.

9.text: Kandi namushyingira umuhungu we, amugirire nk'ibyo yagirira umukobwa we.

10.text: Namuharika ntagabanye ibyokurya bye n'imyambaro ye, ntamwicire igihe.

11.text: Natamukorera ibyo uko ari bitatu, azagende adakoranuwe.

13.text: Kandi umuntu natubīkīra undi, Imana igatuma amugwa mu maboko, nzagutegekera aho azahungira.

14.text: Umuntu natera mugenzi we abyitumye ngo amwicishe uburiganya, umukure ku gicaniro cyanjye ahōrwe.

16.text: “Uwibye umuntu akamugura cyangwa bakamumufatana, ntakabure kwicwa.

18.text: “Abantu nibarwana umwe agakubita undi ibuye cyangwa igipfunsi, akabirwara iminsi ntapfe,

19.text: nasindagirira ku kibando uwamukubise ntazagibweho n'urubanza, ahubwo azarihe iminsi amaze arwaye kandi amuvuze arinde akira neza.

20.text: “Umuntu nakubita inkoni umugurano we w'umugabo cyangwa w'umugore akamukumbanya, ntazabure guhanwa.

21.text: Ariko nasibira rimwe cyangwa kabiri, ntashyirweho igihano kuko uwo ari ifeza ye.

22.text: “Kandi abantu nibarwana bakababaza umugore utwite, akavanamo inda ariko ntagire ikindi aba, ntazabure kuriha icyo umugabo w'uwo mugore amurihishije cyose, azarihe nk'uko abacamanza bategetse.

23.text: Ariko nihagira ikindi aba, uzategeke ko ubugingo buhorerwa ubundi,

24.text: ijisho rihorerwa irindi, iryinyo rihorerwa irindi, ikiganza gihorerwa ikindi, ikirenge gihorerwa ikindi,

25.text: ubushye buhorerwa ubundi, uruguma ruhorerwa urundi, umubyimba uhorerwa undi.

26.text: “Umuntu nakubita umugurano we w'umugabo cyangwa w'umugore akamumena ijisho, amuhe umudendezo kuko amumennye ijisho.

27.text: Kandi nakubita umugurano we w'umugabo cyangwa w'umugore akamukura iryinyo, amuhe umudendezo kuko amukuye iryinyo.

28.text: “Inka niyica umugabo cyangwa umugore agapfa, iyo nka ntikabure kwicishwa amabuye kandi ntikaribwe, ariko nyirayo ntazagibweho n'urubanza.

29.text: Ariko niba iyo nka yari isanzwe yica bakaba barabibwiye nyirayo ntayirinde, ikica umugabo cyangwa umugore agapfa, iyo nka yicishwe amabuye, nyirayo na we bamwice.

30.text: Nibamuca ikarabo, atange ibyo bamuciye byose gucungura ubugingo bwe.

31.text: Naho yaba umuhungu w'umuntu cyangwa umukobwa we iyo nka yishe, bimubere uko iryo tegeko ritegetse.

32.text: Inka niyica umugurano w'umugabo cyangwa w'umugore, nyirayo azahe shebuja w'uwo shekeli z'ifeza mirongo itatu, bicishe iyo nka amabuye.

33.text: “Umuntu nasibura urwobo rwacukuriwe kubika amazi, cyangwa narucukura ntarupfundikire inka cyangwa indogobe ikagwamo,

34.text: nyirarwo arihe icyo iguze: ahe nyirayo izo feza, intumbi ibe iya nyir'urwobo.

35.text: “Inka y'umuntu niyica iy'undi igapfa, iyayishe bayigure bagabane ibiguzi byayo, kandi n'intumbi na yo bayigabane.

36.text: Cyangwa nibimenyekana yuko iyo nka yari isanzwe yica, nyirayo ntayirinde, ntazabure kurihaho indi, intumbi ikaba iye.

37.text: “Umuntu niyiba inka cyangwa intama, akayibaga cyangwa akayigura, inka ayiriheho eshanu, intama ayiriheho enye.
